arguments.value: Thomas Selby Ellis III served as a judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia after his nomination by President Ronald Reagan in 1987 and later assumed senior status in 2007. Born in Bogotá, Colombia, he earned a B.S.E. from Princeton University, a J.D. from Harvard Law School, and a Diploma in Law from the University of Oxford. He served in the U.S. Navy from 1961 to 1966, practiced law in Richmond, Virginia, from 1969 to 1987, and lectured in law at the College of William and Mary from 1981 to 1983.
